## Scope

Ship a small offline walkthrough and explicit live interfaces around the native, provider-neutral Decision Flywheel optimizer. Do not add DSPy dependencies, bridges, or optimization paths.

## Definition of done

Documented local workflow, reproducible fixtures, release-ready package, and evidence links for native optimization; no optional DSPy integration is in scope.
description.to: Native provider-neutral APIs, documented offline workflow and client integration; no DSPy. Completion includes usable prediction/feedback/optimization APIs, inspectable actual prompts/replies/tool calls and active classifier versions, verified via decision-flywheel-e1e92986-a121-410a-b8c2-fb467d6b3d88. Do not equate an optimize-save-decide component walkthrough with a working feedback loop.
